Container.Name: octopus-qdrant
Container.Overview: Qdrant vector database container for self-hosted Octopus code embeddings and search.
Container.Requires: Companion vector database for Octopus. Avoid exposing Qdrant directly to the internet. Leave Qdrant API-key auth disabled for this template because current upstream Octopus does not send QDRANT_API_KEY to Qdrant.

Config.Name: Qdrant HTTP Port
Config.Description: Qdrant HTTP API port. The Octopus template defaults to host.docker.internal:43333.

Config.Name: QDRANT__SERVICE__API_KEY
Config.Description: Leave blank for Octopus. Current upstream Octopus does not pass QDRANT_API_KEY to Qdrant, so enabling this will block Octopus connections unless upstream support is added.
